instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, interactive, high-density government administration dashboard in React.
Ensure dark navy (#0F172A) sidebar with active red indicator (#DC2626) and clean light slate body background (#F8FAFC).
Implement all 10 sidebar pages completely with rich mock data (at least 20-30 DAMKAR personnel across 6 Regu).
Ensure the Input Absensi page features multi-select checkboxes and large touch buttons suitable for smartphones and tablets.
Implement rolling assignment functionality in Regu Management with historical tracking dialog.
Include export functionality to Excel (.xlsx mock download) and PDF printable official format complete with Kop Surat Pemkab Mimika.
Use proper data-testid attributes for interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='input-absensi-batch-hdr-btn').
Integrate sonner for notifications when attendance is saved or regu is updated.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Add smooth active/hover states for all status buttons, tables, and tab switches.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high-contrast text on all attendance status badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_ids: Add data-testid to all inputs, status action buttons, navigation tabs, filter dropdowns, and export triggers.
